name: DeepSQL
description: Runs a self-hostable DBA agent for Postgres and MySQL that monitors workloads, rewrites slow queries and proposes indexes, reachable over MCP, CLI or Slack.

skills.name: Query Optimization
skills.description: Analyzes slow queries with execution plans and returns rewritten SQL plus the reasoning behind each change.

skills.name: Index Recommendations
skills.description: Recommends and validates indexes against real workload patterns, estimating the gain before you apply them.

skills.name: Workload Monitoring
skills.description: Watches database health continuously and raises issues such as lock contention, bloat and regressions.
